decision.summary: Landlord approval has been outstanding since January; the note saying a £500+VAT quote was approved has no landlord words behind it, and the holds say we are still waiting for a call-back. I sent the landlord one explicit question with a 17 March deadline, updated the tenant, noted the conflict and put the job on hold with a review date.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: It is at the landlord approval gate. Landlord approval has not been confirmed in the landlord's own words, and no contractor is assigned. The tenant has been waiting since January.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: A clear approve / own-contractor question to the landlord (Jenkins) via the landlord record contact, reply needed by 17 March. The tenant has been updated by email on the existing thread.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. The landlord's decision is theirs to make. If they stay silent past 17 March and a second-channel chase, escalate P2 to maintenance.

conflicts: Event 009 says the landlord approved the £500+VAT quote, but later holds say we are still waiting for the landlord to call back. No landlord words are on record, so I treated approval as unconfirmed.
Events 015-016 mention a contractor through Oakley, which may mean the landlord's own contractor.
assumptions: Jenkins is the landlord; Oakley's role is unclear.

tickets.description:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable
